The teacher leaned forward, a warm smile softening their features as they handed back the graded paper. "I have to say, this recent assignment is quite well done. You really captured the core concepts."

The student took the paper, their shoulders relaxing as a genuine grin spread across their face. "Thank you! I put a lot of extra hours into it, so I'm really glad it shows."

The teacher nodded, their tone encouraging. "It definitely shows. Keep that dedication up."

The color of a common crow is black.
